translationRepairs: On guimao day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.
On guiwei day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.
Focus unit opens with 癸未 (guiwei); English guimao would be 癸卯, a different sexagenary day.
On guimao day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.
On guiwei day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.
Literal likewise mistranslates 癸未 as guimao; guiwei is the correct reading.
On guimao day Mengfu detail-stable Yelü Shensi was made regent of the Central Capital.
On guiwei day Mengfu detail-stable Yelü Shensi was made regent of the Central Capital.
s0067 begins 癸未; guimao (癸卯) is wrong, while the rest of the appointment wording is unchanged and sound.
In the fifth year, on guimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
In the fifth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.
五年春正月癸未 requires guiwei, not guimao, for the first-month travel date.
In the fifth year, spring, first month, on guimao day, went to Yuer Marsh.
In the fifth year, spring, first month, on guiwei day, went to Yuer Marsh.
Literal field has the same 癸未→guimao error; guiwei restores the correct day name.
On guimao day Tide came with tribute.
On guiwei day Tide came with tribute.
s0167 opens with 癸未; replacing guimao with guiwei corrects the day without changing the tribute clause.
On guimao day Tide came with tribute.
On guiwei day Tide came with tribute.
Literal likewise has guimao for 癸未; guiwei is the accurate sexagenary reading.

On guiyou day of the third month an edict ordered Jizhou and Dading prefectures to select examination candidates carefully and report them; scholars were also instructed to exhaust the classics and clarify the Way.

On guiyou day of the third month an edict ordered Xijin and Dading prefectures to select examination candidates carefully and report them; scholars were also instructed to exhaust the classics and clarify the Way.
析津 is the Liao prefecture Xijin (Nanjing/Yanjing), not Jizhou (薊州); Xijin is the correct English place name.

On guiwei day Mengfu detail-stable Yelü Shensi was made regent of the Central Capital.
Literal for s0067 also reads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei matches the Chinese day graph.
